why: Draws debris for a shot that never left the barrel. A refusal is not an impact -- the blocked-fire vocabulary is a HUD cue and a sound -- so particles here would read as a shot that did fire. This is the direction the old hand-kept list could not see at all: `fire-blocked` was named in neither the switch, nor its comment, nor the five-event test, so a burst added here changed nothing any assertion was watching. The sweep now walks the whole union and compares what drew against what should.
killedBy: particles: which events burst, and how much draws for exactly the events it means to, swept across the whole SimEvent union
